diseases.name: Pregnancy (confirm with test)
diseases.inv: Urine pregnancy test; ultrasound for location and dating.
diseases.alt: PCOS, thyroid disease, stress, ectopic pregnancy

diseases.name: Miscarriage
diseases.inv: Ultrasound, β-hCG, blood group and Rh.
diseases.alt: Ectopic pregnancy, molar pregnancy, cervical lesion

diseases.name: Placenta praevia
diseases.inv: Urgent ultrasound; do NOT perform a digital vaginal examination.

diseases.name: Placental abruption
diseases.inv: Urgent obstetric assessment, CTG, CBC, coagulation, blood group.

diseases.name: Cervical pathology (including cervical cancer)
diseases.inv: Speculum examination, Pap smear/HPV test, colposcopy.

diseases.name: Polycystic ovary syndrome
diseases.inv: Pelvic ultrasound, androgens, TSH, prolactin; Rotterdam criteria apply to adult women.
diseases.tool: Rotterdam criteria define PCOS in adults; apply separately.
diseases.alt: Thyroid disease, hyperprolactinaemia, congenital adrenal hyperplasia

diseases.name: Heavy menstrual bleeding (hormonal, structural or bleeding disorder)
diseases.inv: Haemoglobin, ferritin, TSH, ultrasound; bleeding disorder screen if suggestive.

diseases.name: Pelvic inflammatory disease
diseases.inv: Pregnancy test, swabs, ultrasound; STI screening.

diseases.name: Vulvovaginal candidiasis
diseases.inv: Clinical; high vaginal swab if recurrent. Check glucose.

diseases.name: Trichomoniasis
diseases.inv: Wet mount / NAAT; treat partner; STI screen.

diseases.name: Pre-eclampsia / eclampsia
diseases.inv: Urgent BP measurement, urine protein, liver and kidney tests, platelets; obstetric review.

flags.text: Painful bleeding in pregnancy with hard tender uterus: possible abruption, obstetric emergency
Painless fresh bleeding in late pregnancy: possible placenta praevia, no vaginal examination, urgent care
Bleeding in pregnancy: needs urgent assessment
Bleeding after delivery: possible postpartum haemorrhage, emergency
Raised BP or swelling in pregnancy with visual disturbance or upper abdominal pain: possible severe pre-eclampsia
Late period with bleeding or pain: exclude ectopic pregnancy
